entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return. Order number is VF-8675309.
Okay, I'm pulling that up now. One moment... I see the order is for a VeloFit Aero helmet. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue?
The issue is I want to return it. It's a simple yes or no. Can I return this helmet or not?
I can certainly check that for you. Is it a technical fault with the helmet, or more of a preference issue?
Listen, the box unopened. I just don't like the color. It's been sitting here for a while and I just want to send it back. I don't have time for a dozen questions.
I understand completely. No problem at all. Let me just check the delivery date... Okay, I see it was delivered 69 days ago. You're well within our 90-day return window for standard items.

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return for you. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next five minutes. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear, especially when it comes to safety. A full refund will be issued to your original payment method once we receive the item.
Okay, that's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
